segments.name: banking
segments.description: Provides lending and deposit products and services to small and medium-sized businesses, individuals, estates, local governments and non-profits in Virginia and northern North Carolina.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through two reportable operating segments: banking and wealth management.

segments.name: wealth management
segments.description: Provides fiduciary, investment management and estate services to individuals, estates and other clients.
segments.evidence: Wealth management services include estate planning, investment management of assets, trustee under an agreement, trustee under a will, individual retirement accounts, and estate settlement.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net interest income on loans and investments plus noninterest income from deposit service charges, wealth management fees, and ATM and check card fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Noninterest income is derived primarily from service charges on deposits, fee income from wealth management services, and ATM and check card fees.
